---
title: "KEGG pathway"
output: html_document
date: "2026-11-05"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r libraries}
library(pathview)
```

```{r genes}
gene_fc <- c(
  "3099" =  1.5,  # HK2
  "6513" =  1.2,  # SLC2A1
  "5213" =  1.1,  # PFKM
  "226"  =  0.8,  # ALDOA
  "2597" =  0.9,  # GAPDH
  "5315" =  1.3,  # PKM
  "3939" =  1.7,  # LDHA
  "5160" = -1.0,  # PDHA1
  "5162" = -0.8   # PDHB
)

# Paint expression changes onto glycolysis pathway
pathview(
  gene.data = gene_fc,
  pathway.id = "00010",
  species = "hsa",
  kegg.native = TRUE
)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.align='center', out.width='90%'}
knitr::include_graphics(c("hsa00010.pathview.png"))
```

```{r metabolites}
# Hypothetical metabolite abundance changes
# KEGG Compound IDs and log2 fold changes

metabolite_fc <- c(
  "C00031" =  1.2,  # Glucose
  "C00022" =  0.8,  # Pyruvate
  "C00186" =  2.0   # Lactate
)

# Integrate gene expression and metabolite data
pathview(
  gene.data = gene_fc,
  cpd.data = metabolite_fc,
  pathway.id = "00010",
  species = "hsa",
  kegg.native = TRUE
)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.align='center', out.width='90%'}
knitr::include_graphics(c("hsa00010.pathview.png"))
```
